settlements_read: ROY. DE ALGARVE, Faro, Tavira, Silves, Lagos, Estombar
note: MAPGEN-027 constitutional audit. MAPGEN-026 withheld this cell because the plate letters it ROYAUME DE ALGARVE, and a map title is not evidence about an actor - in either direction. Seven institutional axes say one crown: one royal style, one Chancellaria mor through which every law is published, one livro das Leys, acts binding 'Portugal, ou nos Algarves' in a single clause, two ordinary comarcas under crown corregedores and the Ordenacoes, the decima, no Algarve Cortes and no Algarve high court. Naples and Sicily each had a parliament, a council and a viceroy; the Algarve has none of the three. Every settlement engraved in the cell - Faro, Tavira, Silves, Lagos, Estombar - is Portuguese.

settlements_read: Miranda (do Douro), Torre de Moncorvo, Lamego
note: all three are Portuguese comarca towns. Miranda do Douro sits ON the frontier and is Portuguese; no Spanish settlement is engraved anywhere inside this cell, so the one-crown rule applies here exactly as it does inland.
